messages:
Maya: Found a tiny string of fairy lights tangled around a ceramic gnome on my desk. 10/10 holiday energy. Anyone want a tiny festive roommate? (pic attached)
Jon: Omg adopt it!!! name ideas? :heart_eyes:
Priya: I vote for `Sir Sparklepots` :sparkles:
Samir: If no one claims it, I'm bringing it to the kitchen counter and it will live next to the coffee jar. Fair warning. :coffee:
Lena: I will take it if Maya can't keep it — desk gnomes are my love language. :gnome:
Maya: @Lena noted. Also open to a mini poll — react with :one: for "Glowy", :two: for "Sir Sparklepots", :three: for "Biscuit", :four: for "No Name, Just Light"
Jon: Reacted :one:
Priya: :two: (strongly)
Samir: :three: — Biscuit sounds like a caffeinated friend
Lena: :one: +1 for Glowy
holiday-bot: Holiday drop reminder: free items left in the kitchen will be put in the Lost & Found bin on Friday at 5pm. :package:
Maya: Thanks @holiday-bot — if Lena claims it before Friday I can drop it off at her desk after standup.
Lena: I'll be in at 10:30, can swing by Maya's desk. If Maya owes me a cookie in return, that's a fair trade. :cookie:
Priya: Please take a photo of the gnome with its lights on. This is for science.
Maya: Attached another pic — lights on, looks like a tiny woodland nightclub. Low-res glamour shot included. :camera_with_flash:
Jon: Need a tiny playlist for the woodland nightclub. Suggestions: "Frosty Beats" or "Merry Lo-Fi" :headphones:
Samir: I'll make a quick 10-track playlist. Dropping link in #music later.
Maya: OK @Lena it's officially yours if you want. I'll leave it on the corner of my desk by 10:35. Enjoy the tiny roommate and please don't make it pay rent. :grin:
Lena: Adopted! Thanks Maya. Will name it Glowy and promise to keep it away from baking experiments. :raised_hands:
Jon: Congrats Glowy. Welcome to the team.
Priya: +1 to Glowy. Send us a glamour shot when it has a tiny sweater.
Maya: Will do. Also noted for future: small gnomes can be reclaimed by holiday committee if they start to form a conga line. :sweat_smile:
